versions.changelog:
## Festival Stalls Plus 1.0

First release.

- Egg Festival: Egg (80g), Potato Seeds (50g) and Cauliflower Seeds (80g).
- Flower Dance: Tulip (50g) and Blue Jazz (80g).
- Luau: Melon Seeds (80g), Blueberry Seeds (80g) and Pepper Seeds (40g).
- Dance of the Moonlight Jellies: Pumpkin Seeds (100g), Cranberry Seeds (240g) and Eggplant Seeds (20g), ready for fall 1.
- Spirit's Eve: Pumpkin (480g), Pumpkin Pie (580g) and Cranberry Candy (270g).
- Festival of Ice: Chowder (210g), Fish Stew (270g) and Winter Seeds (50g).
- Feast of the Winter Star: Plum Pudding (390g), Cookie (210g) and Holly (120g).
- Seeds cost what Pierre asks in his shop, the other goods 1.5 times their sell price, up to 10 per day.
- Every booth keeps its own stock. The Stardew Valley Fair is not changed.

## Festival Stalls Plus 1.1

The Night Market joins in.

- The magic shop boat at the Night Market now sells a little more each night, up to 10 of each per day:
- Night 1 (winter 15): Crystal Fruit (230g) and Coral (120g).
- Night 2 (winter 16): Snow Yam (150g) and Sea Urchin (240g).
- Night 3 (winter 17): Crocus (90g) and Nautilus Shell (180g).
- Same price rule as before: 1.5 times the sell price, so nothing can be sold back at a profit. The boat's own stock stays as it is.
- The Desert Festival is not changed: its shops take Calico Eggs, not gold. All booths from 1.0 stay exactly as they were.

## Festival Stalls Plus 1.2

Choose your prices.

- New config setting "Prices" for every good this pack adds to the booths: Fair (1.25 times the sell price), Normal (1.5 times, default) or Steep (2 times), rounded up to 10g.
- Normal keeps the prices of 1.0 and 1.1, so nothing changes unless you pick another level. Fair example: Egg 70g, Pumpkin 400g, Crystal Fruit 190g. Steep example: Egg 100g, Pumpkin 640g, Crystal Fruit 300g.
- Even at Fair nothing can be sold back at a profit, also not with the Rancher or Tiller profession.
- Seeds still cost what Pierre asks, at every level. Each booth's own stock, the daily limits and the festivals from 1.0 and 1.1 stay as they were.
